rationale: Combination of opening tie line l13 and shedding 15 MW at bus 3 reduces l12 flow from 118 to 96 MW (within 100 MW limit) and l23 flow to 78 MW (within 90 MW limit). Total load shed is 15 MW (within 25 MW max) using 2 actions (within max 2). This minimizes shedding compared to alternative feasible combination (shed_bus3_15 + shed_bus2_10 = 25 MW).
